meta.tagline: Public bulletin for Nepal’s northern internet and telephony routing
meta.description: Independent public board for the Galchhi–Rasuwagadhi corridor: NTC and China Telecom / CTGNet transit, microwave restoration, satellite backup notes, and live BGP paths.
meta.notOfficial: Not affiliated with NTC, Ncell, NTA, or China Telecom

home.title: Galchhi–Rasuwagadhi network status
home.lead: A public, cited board for the fiber, microwave, and cross-border links that carry Nepal’s northern internet and telephony toward China — and for how those prefixes are being routed right now.
home.districtsNote: Roll-up from NTC public statements. “Remaining” means not yet back in service at that time.
home.routingCtaNote: Observed from RIPE RIS and linked to Hurricane Electric. China-side paths can be under-counted.
home.howToReadBody: Green/amber/red chips are curated from public NTC and news reports, with an as-of time. The routing page is a separate, live observation of BGP — not a substitute for those field reports.
home.starlinkNote: Starlink is not a licensed public restoration path in Nepal. Notes below record policy status and rumoured use only.

corridor.title: Corridor and sites
corridor.lead: The Kathmandu–China terrestrial path via Galchhi, Trishuli, Syabrubesi and Rasuwagadhi, plus the secondary Tatopani–Khasa crossing. Microwave radio is the documented backup north of Trishuli while fiber is cut.
corridor.mapHint: OpenStreetMap. Pins only for places with known coordinates — unnamed reports stay in the list.

satellites.title: Satellites over the flood corridor
satellites.lead: Public NASA daily true-color of the Galchhi–Rasuwagadhi valley from the day before the flood, plus live positions of Earth-observing satellites. This is geography and spacecraft, not people.
satellites.caveat: VIIRS true-color is hundreds of metres per pixel and the monsoon is often cloudy — you will not see a fiber cut. We do not locate phones, vehicles, or people. Starlink overhead is not a licensed internet service in Nepal.
satellites.imageryHint: Date starts at 25 August 2026 (day before the flood). Cloud is weather, not “no data.”
satellites.liveHint: ISS, Sentinel, Landsat, Terra/Aqua, NOAA-20/21. Positions from public TLEs (CelesTrak). Updated every few seconds.
satellites.error: Live catalog unavailable. Imagery still works. Try Worldview below.
satellites.noneNear: None of the tracked Earth-observing satellites are over the box right now.
satellites.credit: Imagery: NASA EOSDIS GIBS. Orbits: CelesTrak TLEs. Map: OpenStreetMap.

routing.title: How traffic is being routed
routing.lead: Live view of Nepal Telecom (AS23752) as seen by RIPE RIS route collectors, with links into Hurricane Electric, Cloudflare Radar, and NTC’s own looking glass.
routing.caveat: RIPE RIS does not see every China-side path. If CTGNet (AS23764) is missing here, that does not prove the Rasuwagadhi–Kerung session is down. If it is present, that is strong evidence the BGP session is up. Corridor fiber cuts are recorded on the Status and Corridor pages, not inferred from this panel.
routing.loading: Fetching RIPE RIS… path dumps can take up to 20 seconds.
routing.error: Live RIS data is unavailable right now. Use the Hurricane Electric and RIPEstat links below.
routing.pathChipNote: Repeated AS23752 hops are prepending (NTC engineering), not extra networks.

bulletin.title: Bulletin
bulletin.lead: Curated, cited updates. These are not press releases from this site — they summarise public NTC, news, and routing observations.

reports.title: Field reports
reports.lead: Unofficial public notes filed as GitHub Issues. They are not NTC status, and they are not copied onto the corridor map until a maintainer verifies them.
reports.disclaimer: Anyone with a GitHub account can file a report. Treat these as tips, not official outage data. Do not post personal phone numbers or photos of people without consent.
reports.error: Could not load GitHub Issues. Open the repository to read or file reports.

about.title: About this board
about.lead: Independent public information. Not a telecom operator, not a government site, and not a substitute for 1155 / NTC customer care.
about.whatBody: Corridor and site status from named public sources; live BGP as observed by RIPE RIS; links to Hurricane Electric and operator looking glasses; and a space for unofficial field reports.
about.whatNotBody: We do not speak for Nepal Telecom, Ncell, NTA, China Telecom, or Starlink. We do not publish how to run unlicensed satellite terminals. Starlink remains unlicensed in Nepal as of June 2026.
about.methodBody: Human-edited JSON and Markdown in git. Every status chip has an as-of time and a source. Routing is fetched in your browser from RIPEstat (sourceapp=netgalchi-rasuwagadhi). HE.net has no public JSON API, so we link to it rather than scrape it.
about.updateBody: Edit src/data/*.json or add a paired English/Nepali bulletin, then open a pull request. Verified field reports can be copied into sites.json by a maintainer — they are never merged automatically.
about.credit: Hosted on GitHub Pages by ashiskharel. Contributions welcome.
